title: ExchangeDesk 3.4.0 (Production Launch & Security Edition)
notes: 🔒 Enterprise JWT & PIN Security: Encrypted session tokens and bcrypt hashed PINs for buyer, showroom & admin
🔔 Notification Center: Live alert drawer with unread counter for outbid alerts, won auctions, and announcements
⚡ 24/7 KeepAlive Heartbeat: Cloud backend stays continuously awake with 0-second cold-start response times
📸 Camera & Storage Permissions: Android 13/14 native media permissions with smart photo compression
🛡️ Anti-Impersonation Bidding: Bids cryptographically signed and verified by authenticated user tokens
